messages.text: C99-6502 is a cycle-accurate emulator for the MOS 6502 microprocessor, written entirely in C99.
MOS 6502 is the CPU that powered classic computers like the Apple II, Commodore 64, and the original NES.
My emulator replicates both the original NMOS 6502 and the enhanced CMOS 65C02 variants.
It's cycle-accurate, meaning it mimics the exact timing behavior of the real hardware.
Modular architecture with a flexible bus interface and region-based memory management for RAM, ROM, and I/O.
Supports all official opcodes, NMOS undocumented opcodes, and the full 65C02 instruction set with bit manipulation extensions.
Also, it passes the Klaus Dormann 6502 functional test suite, which runs about 30.6 million cycles to verify correctness.
